title: Mvula: compressing ECMWF AIFS for laptop-scale African weather experimentation
description:
Public citable snapshot of Mvula v5 (ECMWF Code for Earth 2026, African Stream). The Track B student is about 8.8 MiB and is evaluated as one-step, analysis-forced African 2 m temperature on a laptop CPU.

This release does not claim a free-run, autoregressive, or 10-day forecast, full 65-channel output, precipitation skill, or smartphone deployment. Third-party AIFS teacher weights are not included and remain under their original terms.

Source code is Apache-2.0. Documentation in the repository is CC BY 4.0. Mentors: Shruti Nath, Rendani Mbuvha, Mario Santa Cruz López.
